newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-DAHLIN SAID TO BE MULLING AJAX OFFER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DAHLIN SAID TO BE MULLING AJAX OFFER.

text.p: Sweden and Borussia Moenchengladbach striker Martin Dahlin is considering an offer to join Ajax, the Swedish daily Expressen reported on Friday.
"I have had a serious request from Ajax and it seems interesting. (Ajax manager) Morten Olsen has said he wants to buy me," the 29-year-old Dahlin told the daily.
Dahlin, a mercurial striker who combines flashes of genius with periods of ineffectiveness, has said he wants to leave the German club at the end of this season.
"I've told the club I won't be carrying on at Moenchengladbach...Italy is attractive but Ajax is also a good alternative. I'm keeping all doors open," he was quoted as saying.
